You have transcended the boundary between craft and art. Every creation that leaves your hands is a testament to absolute mastery - functional, beautiful, and built to endure. Your workshop is a temple of productivity, and you are its high priest.\n\nTRADEOFF: Total dedication to the craft leaves little energy for haste.

Your intellect has reached a plane where invention is effortless. Complex mechanisms unfold in your mind like origami - you see the solution before you understand the problem. The things you create push the boundaries of what anyone thought possible on this world.\n\nTRADEOFF: Genius-level focus comes at the cost of social awareness.

You are a living engine of productivity. Where others collapse from exhaustion, you simply shift to a different task. Your stamina is legendary - colonists tell stories about the time you worked for three days straight without sleeping and produced better results than anyone managed in a week.\n\nTRADEOFF: Your obsessive work ethic leaves little room for combat training.

You are the embodiment of plenty. Every animal in your care produces beyond its natural limits, every plant you tend grows as if blessed by some forgotten harvest god. The colony's stores overflow with your work - famine is a word that loses its meaning when you're on the job.\n\nTRADEOFF: Your deep connection to nature leaves less mental bandwidth for pure research.

You have achieved the ultimate synthesis of skill and insight. Your hands move with a purpose that transcends conscious thought - every creation is imbued with the full depth of your experience. At Crafting 20, the world bends to your workmanship like clay to a potter's wheel.\n\n[GIMMICK TIER 4]: Up to +75% Work Speed at Crafting 20. The pinnacle of the craft.

You have reached the pinnacle of offensive swordsmanship. Your strikes are so fast they blur, so precise they find gaps in armor that shouldn't exist. Combat against you isn't a fight - it's an execution with extra steps.\n\nTRADEOFF: Extreme aggression sacrifices defensive posture.

Attacks pass through where you were a heartbeat ago. Blades miss by millimeters that feel like miles. You have achieved such mastery over movement that hitting you in melee requires luck that borders on the miraculous. Your enemies exhaust themselves swinging at ghosts.

Your counters have become so refined that each riposte targets nerve clusters and pressure points. The pain you inflict is disproportionate to the wound itself - a shallow cut that drops enemies to their knees, screaming.\n\nTRADEOFF: The constant vigilance required for perfect counters erodes your mental resilience.

You are the end of the fight. Your blade falls with the inevitability of a headsman's axe, and your body absorbs punishment that would kill anyone else outright. Pain fuels you. Wounds make you more dangerous. Enemies who manage to hurt you quickly realize they've only made their situation worse.\n\nNothing survives sustained combat with you.

You have achieved the pinnacle of reactive combat. Incoming attacks are no longer threats - they are fuel. Every dodged blow charges your response, and when you finally strike, it carries the accumulated force of every attack that failed to land. At maximum stacks, a single counter blow can end a fight.\n\n[GIMMICK TIER 4]: Max 10 charges, +10% melee damage each (max +100%). One perfect counter. One devastating blow.

Your reputation precedes you across the planet. Faction leaders speak your name with a mixture of respect and wariness, knowing that a conversation with you can reshape the political landscape overnight. Every word you speak carries the weight of absolute conviction.\n\nTRADEOFF: Your focus on words over weapons has dulled your combat edge.

You are the most formidable trader on the Rim. Caravans adjust their routes to visit your colony specifically, knowing that while you'll drive a hard bargain, the deals you broker are always fair enough to keep them coming back. Your colony grows wealthy not through conquest, but through commerce.\n\nTRADEOFF: Your mercantile obsession comes at the expense of hands-on productivity.

You embody the rule of law. Prisoners cannot resist your authority, colonists cannot defy it, and even raiders hesitate when they see you standing firm. Your colony runs with the precision of a well-oiled machine because everyone knows their role - and everyone knows who's in charge.\n\nTRADEOFF: Your rigid discipline leaves little room for physical agility.

You command animals the way a general commands soldiers. Your menagerie is a force multiplier that transforms a modest colony into an empire. Thrumbos kneel, bears stand guard, and wargs hunt on your command - each one an extension of your indomitable will.\n\nTRADEOFF: Your deep bond with beasts comes at the cost of human social finesse.

You are the beating heart of your colony. Every soul under your banner draws strength from your presence, and every new face that joins the cause amplifies your authority further. Your mind becomes a living archive of all knowledge. Research is a mere formality - you have already read the answers. But the obsession never sleeps.\n\nTRADEOFF: Consuming pursuit of knowledge destabilises the psyche.

The mage has achieved perpetual enlightenment. Mind and body are in perfect harmony - illness cannot take hold, the spirit replenishes endlessly, and mental crises simply cease to occur.\n\nA soul at peace is immune to the chaos of the world.

The mage has wrapped themselves in a shell of absolute void energy. Nothing penetrates - not poison, not blight, not despair, not steel. But the weight of maintaining such constant awareness slows their steps.\n\nTRADEOFF: Total protection at the cost of mobility.

The ultimate conjuration - the mage has discovered the formula for immortality. Disease cannot win, rest restores everything, and poison loses all meaning. The secret of eternal vitality is unlocked.\n\nConverts all ailments to mere inconveniences.

The mage has transcended ordinary consciousness. Their mind and aetheric field have fused into a single, perfect instrument of cosmic will. You are no longer simply large - you are a force of nature. Weapons shatter against your frame. Your presence on the battlefield warps the flow of combat entirely.\n\nTRADEOFF: Sheer mass slows movement.

You have stared at death so many times it has given up trying. Every disease, toxin, and physical trauma that should have ended you has only made you more terrifyingly resilient.\n\nTRADEOFF: Your obsession with survival leaves little room for peace of mind.

You do not fight to dominate. You fight to protect. But those who threaten what you guard will learn that the most dangerous blow is the one from a defender who has finally had enough.\n\nThe wall does not merely stand. It strikes back.

You have pulled too many people back from the edge. The dying, the broken, the despairing - they all find their way back because you refused to let them go. It is not a gift. It is a vow.\n\nYou protect them. All of them. Always.

There is no longer hesitation between seeing and firing. Your body has become a single unified system: eye, hand, weapon, target, impact. The shot is released before the conscious mind even registers the opportunity.\n\nTRADEOFF: Reflexive precision dulls close-quarters instincts.

You don't walk. You flow. Terrain that slows others barely registers. In combat, you reposition with a fluidity that borders on precognitive. The battlefield is your hunting ground, and you dominate every sightline simultaneously.

Your territory is a deathtrap disguised as open land. Every path funnels, every clearing is pre-sighted, and every trap is positioned with geometric precision. Enemies don't invade your perimeter - they enter your kill zone.\n\nTRADEOFF: Obsessive preparation erodes social warmth.

Every animal in the colony recognizes you as the apex. Wild thrumbos that terrify seasoned hunters lower their heads when you approach. Your pack fights with coordinated lethality, your herds produce abundantly, and nothing on four legs defies you.\n\nYou are the apex predator - even without a weapon.

The hunt is over. You are no longer learning to track, aim, and kill - you have been doing it so long that the prey never had a chance. Every shot lands. Every target falls. The rimworld's deadliest creatures flee from you now.\n\n[GIMMICK TIER 4]: Max 7 stacks, +7% accuracy each (max +49%). Sustained fire turns you into a ballistic nightmare.

Your mind no longer just processes information - it generates it. Entire fields of knowledge have been catalogued, cross-indexed, and mastered. You are, in the most literal sense, the most capable intellect in the settlement.\n\nTRADEOFF: Obsessive pursuit of knowledge strains mental clarity.

You have simply stopped breaking. Not because the world has become kinder - it hasn't - but because the part of you that could be shattered has been dissolved away through years of deliberate practice.\n\nYou are present. You are clear. Nothing moves you.

There is a bond between you and the people of this colony that goes beyond language. Without words, they know you are on their side. With words, you can move mountains - or stop wars.\n\nYou are not just trusted. You are beloved.

There are cases in the colony's records that no one talks about in professional settings - the ones where the patient statistically should have died, and didn't, specifically and only because you were in the room.\n\nYou don't call it a miracle. You call it preparation.

This is the end of the path. Beyond thought. Beyond effort. Everything you know, everything you can do, operating at absolute peak - because nothing is interfering.

This is what you were meant to become.
